digest.component_or_area: LLM provider seam and bedrock integration
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime branches on provider-name strings instead of using pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook, preventing extensibility to bedrock and custom openai-compatible endpoints

bedrock-hosted anthropic claude is not natively supported; pr 121 proposed openai-compatible gateway but loses prompt caching, retrying transport, per-request timeouts, and structured output capability
documentation claims REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY work but _pai_check_config refuses them, making the documented interface false

bedrock retry and timeout configuration does not reach the actual bedrock client; the tenacity transport and httpx timeout exist only on the direct-anthropic path, leaving production bedrock unconfigured
signed verdict sidecars record only a model string and do not expose provider, endpoint host, or support tier, preventing consumers from distinguishing first-class from best-effort calls
output-mode selection hardcodes _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS name set instead of reading real capability flags from pydantic-ai ModelProfile
